headline: **MLB Daily Recap: July 18, 2026**
article:
The Boston Red Sox dominated the Tampa Bay Rays in a shutout loss, while the Los Angeles Dodgers edged out the New York Yankees in a thrilling 2-1 victory. The Atlanta Braves routed the Texas Rangers 15-1, and the Baltimore Orioles bolstered their roster with the addition of outfielder Rudy Martin Jr.

Injuries continue to plague several teams, with the Baltimore Orioles transferring Chris Bassitt to the 60-day injured list due to low back discomfort. The St. Louis Cardinals placed JoJo Romero on the 15-day injured list retroactive to July 14, 2026, while the Houston Astros placed Brice Matthews on the 10-day injured list retroactive to July 14, 2026, with a left knee sprain.

The Baltimore Orioles acquired outfielder Rudy Martin Jr. from the Kansas City Royals in exchange for cash, while the Milwaukee Brewers made a significant trade with the Houston Astros, acquiring right-hander Lance McCullers Jr. and left-hander Colton Gordon in exchange for outfielder Jadyn Fielder.

top_news.title: **Rays Suffer Shutout Loss to Red Sox**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox dominated the Tampa Bay Rays 10-0, handing them a decisive defeat. Carlos Narváez led the Red Sox offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance, including a key three-run homer.

top_news.title: **Rays Fall to Red Sox in 3-5 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox secured a 3-5 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays, with Wilyer Abreu leading the Red Sox offense with 2 hits, 2 home runs, and 3 RBIs. Aroldis Chapman earned the save for the Red Sox, while Greg Weissert was credited with the win.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Take Down Yankees in Thrilling 2-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers edged out the New York Yankees 2-1, with Max Muncy leading the offense and Jack Dreyer securing the win.

top_news.title: **Braves Rout Rangers 15-1**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves dominated the Texas Rangers in a one-sided game, securing a 15-1 victory. Drake Baldwin led the Rangers' offense with 3 hits, including a home run, and 5 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Bassitt Shifted to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Baltimore Orioles right-hander Chris Bassitt has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to low back discomfort. This move will keep Bassitt sidelined for at least the next 60 days.

top_news.title: **Orioles Acquire Rudy Martin Jr. in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles have bolstered their roster with the addition of outfielder Rudy Martin Jr., who was traded to the team from the Kansas City Royals in exchange for cash. Martin Jr. joins the Orioles' active roster following the trade.
